title: Agent Project Guides package manifest
description: PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json as written by `apg release manifest` from the mode boundary on (3.0.11 on the 3.0 line, 4.0.1 on the 4.x line). `files[]` is the complete package payload and a subset of the repository tree - a consumer must install exactly these paths, never the whole checkout. `files[].mode` is the file's POSIX permission mask in decimal (420 = 0o644, 493 = 0o755) and is covered by `digest`; a publisher refuses to emit any mode carrying 0o022. Manifests published before the boundary carry no mode and stay verifiable on their own shape, but this schema describes the current format only.
